amendment_notes: Versioned protocol amendment: isolates test bucket under 80/10/10 split policy, defines primary estimand as across-seed single-model replication with paired whole-game bootstrap CI on mean seed loss delta, adds unseen-position evaluation and gating, and enforces measured JVM extraction cost evidence in candidate selection.

S0.description: The served baseline: 7 material, mobility_diff, king_safety_diff, 4 capture probabilities.

S1.description: S0 plus 12 pseudo-legal move counts per piece type for both sides and 2 piece diversity indices (own_pdi, opp_pdi).

S2.description: S1 plus 2 passed-pawn counts and 2 max passed-pawn ranks for both sides.

estimand.description: Mean and standard deviation across independent seed trainings of the single serving model.

slices.phase: opening: ply<=10; otherwise endgame: total_material<=20; else middlegame
slices.material: behind: material_diff<-1; balanced: abs(material_diff)<=1; ahead: material_diff>1
slices.target: decisive: binary observed outcome; uncertain: unsupported without teacher probabilities
